preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= start < end < N for start, end, weight in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertices such that 0 <= start < end < N.

preconditions.expression: all(weight > 0 for start, end, weight in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge must have a positive weight.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min((dist[N-1] if dist[N-1] != float('inf') else -1) for dist in all_shortest_paths)
postconditions.description: The function returns the weight of the shortest path from vertex 0 to vertex N-1, or -1 if no such path exists.
